cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar before lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then loosen the lid. Don't make the opening smaller than necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labelling. We mustn't confuse it with tomorrow.

mechanism: A corrects container handling while assigning B an impossible time-recovery task and reserving simple documentation for themself.
confusable: Finding strange-world rules differs from D149; A must refuse to own the impossible execution even while claiming competence.
comparison: A missing-hour record task differs from a public film event's labor negotiation.
seedUse: Retain jar and labeling division; establish why the hour must be recovered so the task has immediate stakes.
